title: Telling the time
examples: Teacher, how do I know which hand is the hour hand?
If the minute hand is on the six, what time is it?
Can you show me what quarter past means?

explain.say: Look at this clock face for us today.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: an analogue clock. Can you see the hour hand and the minute hand? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
The shorter hand tells us the hour number.
The longer hand tells us the minutes past the hour.
When both hands point straight up, it is o'clock.
When the minute hand is on the six, it is half past.
For example, if the short hand is at 4 and the long hand is at 6, it is half past four.

faq.q: What is the difference between o'clock and half past?
faq.a: O'clock means the minute hand is on the twelve. Half past means the minute hand is on the six.
asks: When is it exactly on the hour?
What does the six on the clock mean?

faq.q: Does the hour hand move when it is half past?
faq.a: Yes, the hour hand moves halfway between the two numbers. It does not just stay on the first number.
asks: Does the short hand move a bit?
If it is half past, where is the hour hand?

faq.q: If the minute hand is at the six, what is the time?
faq.a: If the minute hand is at the six, it means thirty minutes have passed. This is called half past.
asks: What time is when the long hand points to six?
How many minutes is the six on the clock?

faq.q: Do I always read the hour first?
faq.a: Yes, we usually say the hour first. We say 'four' before we say 'half past'.
asks: What do I say first when telling time?
Should I say the minutes or the hour first?

faq.q: How many minutes are there on the clock?
faq.a: There are sixty minutes in one full hour. The clock face shows us parts of that sixty.
asks: How many minutes are in an hour?
What does the clock count up to?

facts: The minute hand moves around the clock face.
The hour hand moves slowly around the clock face.
O'clock means the minute hand points to the twelve.
Half past means the minute hand points to the six.

quiz.say: If the short hand is on 7 and the long hand is on 12, what time is it?
quiz.why: When the long hand is on the twelve, it means zero minutes, so it is exactly on the hour.

wrong.0: We only use the hour number when the long hand is on twelve.
wrong.2: This confuses the twelve with the six.
wrong.3: You must look at where the short hand is pointing.

quiz.say: If the short hand is between 2 and 3, and the long hand is on 6, what time is it?
quiz.why: The long hand on six means thirty minutes, which is half past. The short hand shows the hour.

wrong.0: The short hand is not pointing at three yet.
wrong.1: We say 'half past' instead of adding 'o'clock' at the end.
wrong.3: This ignores the fact that the long hand is on the six.

quiz.say: What time is shown when the short hand is on 10 and the long hand is on 12?
quiz.why: When the long hand is on the twelve, it means the time is exactly on the hour.

wrong.0: You must read the number the short hand is pointing to.
wrong.1: Thirty minutes means the long hand should be on the six.
wrong.3: Half past means the long hand must be on the six.
